title: Scenario
description: An engine-neutral test: a map, a start, a timeline of inputs, and expectations. Times are in seconds and convert to ticks as described in spec/README.md.

description.description: What the scenario shows, in a sentence or two.

status.description: unverified: written without an engine run; expectations may be tuned once on first run. verified: an engine has passed it; expectations change only for intentional behavior changes.

seed.description: Seed for the sim's RNG. Defaults to 0.

duration.description: Total time to simulate, in seconds.

start.description: The player spawns at the marker's origin raised by 1 unit, at rest, holding the starting weapon ready to fire; the first tick settles it onto the floor.

marker.description: Name of an info_marker in the map.

yaw.description: Facing in degrees; 0 is east (+x), 90 is north (+y).

pitch.description: Pitch in degrees; positive looks up. Defaults to 0.

inputs.description: Consecutive segments. Each holds one set of inputs from the previous segment's end (or 0) until its own 'until'. After the last segment, inputs are neutral with the view held.

expect.description: Checks on the player's state at given times.

until.description: End time of this segment in seconds; must increase from segment to segment.

yaw.description: View yaw in degrees. Carries over from the previous segment (or the start) when omitted.

pitch.description: View pitch in degrees, positive up. Carries over when omitted.

jump.description: Hold jump. Defaults to false in each segment.

attack.description: Hold attack. Defaults to false in each segment.

at.description: Time in seconds at which to check.

note.description: Why this check matters, for whoever reads a failure.

position.description: Expected player origin; null skips an axis. Needs a tolerance.

velocity.description: Expected velocity in units per second; null skips an axis. Needs a tolerance.

tolerance.description: Allowed difference per checked axis of position and velocity.

near_marker.description: The player origin is within this distance of a marker's origin.
